parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outside frame of the trash can, made of stainless steel, provides structural support and houses the internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the container and cover, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the trash can.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: The cover of the trash can, made of durable plastic, is positioned at the top to close the container.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and conceals the waste inside the container.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated open and closed, depending on the trash can’s design.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the inner bin of the trash can, made of plastic, used to hold waste materials.
parts.Functional_description: It collects and stores trash, and can be removed for emptying and cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be pulled out or lifted from the frame for disposal and maintenance.
